site_brief.title: Super for local service businesses handling bookings, quotes, and customer replies

summary: Local service businesses are entering an agent-first market. Google’s Gemini agents can now call contractors, request prices, check availability, and even navigate booking forms on behalf of customers. Super is built for this moment: a personal AI agent that operates real computers, answers booking and quote requests across tools, and reuses a computer-use cache so repeated workflows get faster and cheaper over time.
